title: Design System: Finanzas Personales — El Legajo

display.purpose: The honest total only — the loudest text in the app.

headline.purpose: Card and page headings in the typewriter voice.

title.purpose: Uppercase printed labels on the folder header.

body.purpose: Table rows and reading text — the system voice.

label.purpose: Uppercase typewriter headers, tabs, and stamps.

shadows.name: whisper
shadows.purpose: The only shadow token in light: cards and tooltips.

shadows.name: whisper-night
shadows.purpose: The same single step after dark.

shadows.name: drawer-lift
shadows.purpose: Reversed whisper under the mobile bottom bar.

motion.name: stamp-settle
motion.purpose: The membrete stamps in and settles on load; the only entrance animation, gated on prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button (Stamped Impression)
components.description: Ink-filled submit button with receipt-white text; hover deepens the ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--ink-btn-bg, #2b241a); color: var(--ink-btn-text, #faf6ec); border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--ink-btn-bg-hover, #443826); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--stamp, #a63d2f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button (Red Stamp)
components.description: Stamp-red destructive button; the only red fill in the system.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: var(--stamp, #a63d2f); color: var(--receipt, #faf6ec); border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.35rem 0.8rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--stamp, #a63d2f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Link (Ink Underline)
components.description: Borderless underlined ink text button; red is never a link color.
components.css: .ds-btn-link { border: none; background: none; color: var(--ink, #2b241a); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.85rem; padding: 0.35rem 0; min-height: 44px; } .ds-btn-link:hover { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; } .ds-btn-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--stamp, #a63d2f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field (Receipt Sheet)
components.description: One printed-field baseline: sheet fill, hairline border, typewriter numerals.
components.css: .ds-input { padding: 0.45rem; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #b39a6b); border-radius: 6px; font-size: 0.95rem; background: var(--sheet, #faf6ec); color: var(--ink, #2b241a); caret-color: var(--ink, #2b241a); font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--stamp, #a63d2f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card (Folder Face)
components.description: Manila folder face with hairline border, whisper shadow, and its folder tab.
components.html:
Total del mes

Cada mes, una carpeta.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: var(--card, #ecd9ac); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #b39a6b); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(43, 36, 26, 0.14); } .ds-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -9px; left: 0.75rem; width: 2.4rem; height: 9px; background: inherit; border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #b39a6b); border-bottom: none; border-radius: 4px 4px 0 0; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 1.05rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; margin: 0 0 0.6rem; color: var(--ink, #2b241a); } .ds-card-body { font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; margin: 0; color: var(--ink, #2b241a); }

components.name: Nav Tab (Folder Tab)
components.description: Folder-tab navigation; the active tab is the pulled one — filled, hairline-edged, flush at the bottom.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-tabs button { border: 1px solid transparent; border-bottom: none; border-radius: 6px 6px 0 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted-text, #514533); padding: 0.5rem 0.9rem; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.8rem; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color: var(--ink, #2b241a); } .ds-tabs button.ds-active { background: var(--card, #ecd9ac); border-color: var(--hairline, #b39a6b); color: var(--ink, #2b241a); font-weight: 700; } .ds-tabs button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--stamp, #a63d2f); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Stamp (Badge)
components.description: Hand-tilted ink stamp: uppercase typewriter text in a 2px currentColor frame.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Courier Prime', 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #2b241a); border: 2px solid currentColor; border-radius: 3px; padding: 0.05rem 0.4rem; transform: rotate(-1.5deg); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-stamp-over { color: var(--stamp, #a63d2f); }

narrative.northStar: El Legajo — the Argentine fiscal archive, well kept
narrative.overview: Your money as a filed record: each month a folder, each expense a numbered sheet, each state an ink stamp. Light is the working light over the desk — kraft, manila, receipt paper, brown-black ink, one stamp red. Dark is a scene, not a re-skin: the desk in shadow, the open folder under one warm lamp. Honesty is the visual engine — the honest total is the loudest thing on screen, tables are carried by alignment, and stale data says so with a stamp.
keyCharacteristics: Kraft desk, manila folders, receipt-paper sheets, brown-black ink, one stamp red
Two typographic voices: Courier Prime stationery, system-ui furniture
One folder-tab vocabulary across navigation, months, and card tops
Rule-light tables: hairlines only where meaning demands
The membrete total as the loudest honest element
Dark mode is one warm lamp over the open folder
Mobile drawer edge at ≤640px with 44px targets

rules.name: The Red-Is-a-Stamp Rule
rules.body: Stamp red means a stamp was applied: a destructive act, a warning state, or keyboard focus. Action links and navigation are ink underlines, never red. On the first viewport, the only red is Borrar.

rules.name: The Three-Papers Rule
rules.body: A surface is exactly one of: desk (ground), folder (card), or sheet (receipt). No surface invents a fourth paper, and no surface is pure white.

rules.name: The Warm-Dark-Only Rule
rules.body: The only dark is lamp-warm brown-black. No navy, no blue-dark, no gray-dark clone.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: If it could be typed onto the folder or stamped onto it, it is Courier Prime. If it is interface furniture, it is system-ui. Never swap the voices.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Every rendered amount carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. Columns of money align; digits never wobble.

rules.name: The Loudest-Honest-Total Rule
rules.body: The membrete total (2rem/700 typewriter, tabular) is the loudest element on any screen, and it is never decorated — its size is the honesty.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Dark mode has exactly one light source: the warm radial over the open folder. It never moves, never pulses, and never gains a second source or a cool tint.

dos: Do speak in two voices: Courier Prime for anything printed onto the file, system-ui for interface furniture.
Do set every amount in tabular figures, bold in the typewriter voice, loudest at the membrete total (2rem/700).
Do reserve stamp red for stamps: Borrar, OVER/VENCIDO, stale borders, and the focus ring.
Do use the folder-tab vocabulary for navigation, month picking, and card tops.
Do keep tables rule-light: ink rule under the header, hairline at the group edge, alignment for everything else.
Do keep night as one warm lamp.
Do keep 44px targets, 16px mobile inputs, and the 4.5:1 muted-text floor.
donts: Don't use red for links, navigation, success, or decoration.
Don't invent a fourth surface: the world is desk, folder, and sheet.
Don't grid a table or add zebra rows.
Don't let anything outshout the membrete total.
Don't flatten the hand: stamps without the tilt are labels.
Don't ship a blue-dark or gray-dark theme.
Don't animate into the world beyond the membrete stamp-settle.
